message: Started fixed-FLOPs sweep with medium, then small, then tiny.
Medium completed 474 allocated steps; started evaluation.
Small completed 4,768 allocated steps; started evaluation.
Started tiny candidate with 15,217 allocated steps.
Tiny ended around progress 4,452/15,217 with no evaluation; wrapper nevertheless wrote COMPLETE.
Corrected old claim that medium never reached shortcut training; bootstrap began at step 237 and boot_mse was non-zero.
Added the incomplete pilot to the repository ledger without deleting its negative evidence.
